rationale: Weights represent the empirical contribution of security control dimensions to overall organizational breach resilience, calibrated against VERIS breach root causes.

identity_and_access.rationale: Identity compromise, credential stuffing, and lack of MFA represent >50% of initial breach vectors according to DBIR/VCDB.

vulnerability_management.rationale: Dwell time of known exploitable CVEs directly drives exposure to automated botnet and ransomware operators.

protection.rationale: Data-at-rest encryption, network microsegmentation, and secure baselines limit blast radius and lateral movement.

detection.rationale: Mean time to detect (MTTD), SIEM, and 24/7 SOC telemetry are essential for halting unauthorized dwell before data exfiltration.

recovery.rationale: Air-gapped immutable offline backups determine whether ransomware attacks lead to existential data loss or rapid operational restoration.

response.rationale: Documented and battle-tested incident response playbooks reduce business disruption costs and containment delay.

third_party.rationale: Supply chain monitoring and vendor access management restrict unvetted third-party ingress.

asset_management.rationale: Comprehensive asset discovery ensures no shadow IT or forgotten servers bypass security posture enforcement.
